items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: the quintet of Red Norvo, Morty Feld, Sid Weiss on bass

ctx.x: Let's see, I had left Goodman, of course, in '39 and formed my own big band for a year and a half and cut down to the small six-piece group, or seven-piece group to play the Cafe Society uptown and downtown all during the Second World War, up until 1945 where I rejoined Benny to play in the quintet in the Seven Lively Arts, the quintet of Red Norvo, Morty Feld, Sid Weiss on bass, Morty Feld on drums, Red Norvo and Goodman and myself.
Now that might be where we left off.
